quests.instruction: We wear this on a breezy day when we do not want to feel chilly, but it is not your poncho. What is it?
quests.hint: It makes a soft rustling sound when you move.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Windbreaker is thin and light, yet still blocks a gusty breeze!
quests.funFact: They often feature an elastic waistband and cuffs to seal out the wind.

quests.instruction: We wear this in the kitchen, right before we start cooking dinner, but it is not your pajamas. What is it?
quests.hint: It ties around your neck and waist.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Apron ties over your clothes to protect them from spills and splashes!
quests.funFact: They tie around your waist and sometimes behind your neck.

quests.instruction: We wear this that shows which team or school someone belongs to, but it is not your swimsuit. What is it?
quests.hint: It shows which group someone belongs to.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Uniform is worn by everyone on the same team or school, all matching!
quests.funFact: Sports teams wear identical uniforms so they know who to pass the ball to.

quests.instruction: We wear this on our feet when we relax at home. It is also worn to keep our feet cozy while we walk on cold floors, but it is NOT your flip-flops. What is it?
quests.hint: Hint: They keep your feet warm on a cold floor.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Slippers are soft and easy to slide on, perfect for relaxing at home!
quests.funFact: They are usually very easy to slip on and off without using your hands.

quests.instruction: We wear this closest to our skin, under all our other clothes. It is also worn under our pajamas too, every night before bed, but it is NOT your pants. What is it?
quests.hint: Hint: No one else can see it once you're dressed.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Underwear is worn closest to your skin, under all your other clothes!
quests.funFact: It is washed more frequently than any other piece of clothing.

quests.instruction: We wear this over a shirt, but with no sleeves at all. It is also worn for a fancy outfit, worn over a collared shirt, but it is NOT your t-shirt. What is it?
quests.hint: Hint: You wear this over a shirt.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Vest covers your chest with no sleeves, so your arms stay free!
quests.funFact: Construction workers wear bright, reflective safety vests to be seen easily.

quests.instruction: We wear this under a dress or skirt sometimes for extra warmth. It is also worn with two long legs that go all the way to our ankles, but it is NOT your snowsuit. What is it?
quests.hint: Think about this: They have two long tubes, one for each leg.
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Pants cover both your legs to keep them warm and safe!
quests.funFact: Did you know? pants cover each leg separately all the way down to the ankle.

quests.instruction: We wear this when we run, jump, and play sports. It is also worn instead of dress shoes when we want to move fast, but it is NOT your rain boots. What is it?
quests.hint: Hint: Athletes wear these during a race.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Sneakers have bouncy soles that make running and jumping comfortable!
quests.funFact: They are the most popular type of everyday shoe in the world.

quests.instruction: We wear this that swishes gently when we walk. It is also worn instead of pants, with a shirt on top, but it is NOT your shorts. What is it?
quests.hint: Think about this: It is worn with a top, not by itself.
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Skirt hangs down from your waist and can swish as you walk!
quests.funFact: Did you know? in some cultures, traditional skirts are worn by both men and women.

quests.instruction: Think carefully: we wear this that gives our fingers a cozy, warm hug, not your tie. What is it?
quests.hint: Here's a tip: You wear these to make a snowball without cold hands.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Gloves keep every finger warm and toasty in cold weather!
quests.funFact: Did you know? they help protect your hands from frostbite in the snow.

quests.instruction: We wear this when it snows and the wind feels icy. It is also worn with our coat on the coldest days of the year, but it is NOT your suspenders. What is it?
quests.hint: Think about this: It can be long and dangly or short and cozy.
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Scarf wraps around your neck to keep it warm and cozy!
quests.funFact: Did you know? some scarves are made of incredibly soft silk.

quests.instruction: We wear this with open straps that let our toes feel the breeze. It is NOT your flip-flops. What is it?
quests.hint: Here's a clue: Your toes can peek out of these!
quests.explanation: Hooray! Your Sandals have open straps that let your feet stay cool in the sun!
quests.funFact: Gladiators in ancient Rome famously wore thick leather sandals.

quests.instruction: Think carefully: we wear this on a cool autumn day before winter arrives, not your cardigan. What is it?
quests.hint: Here's a tip: Grandparents sometimes knit these by hand.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Sweater is soft and warm, perfect for chilly days indoors or out!
quests.funFact: Did you know? they are designed to be pulled over your head instead of buttoned.

quests.instruction: Think carefully: we wear this to stay toasty warm on the coldest days of winter, not your raincoat. What is it?
quests.hint: Here's a tip: It is your best friend on a snowy day.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Coat is thick and warm, worn over everything else in cold weather!
quests.funFact: Did you know? the first coats were made of animal hides thousands of years ago.

quests.instruction: We wear this that buttons up the front. It is also worn first, before we put a jacket on over it, but it is NOT your vest. What is it?
quests.hint: Think about this: It has two sleeves for your arms.
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Shirt covers your chest and back to keep your top half comfy!
quests.funFact: Did you know? shirts usually have collars, sleeves, and buttons down the front.

quests.instruction: We wear this that slides on and off in a single second, but it is not your boots. What is it?
quests.hint: They make a fun slapping sound as you walk.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Flip-Flops have one simple strap and slide on fast for easy beach days!
quests.funFact: They are very lightweight but offer very little support for running.

quests.instruction: Think carefully: we wear this before we put our shoes on in the morning, not your slippers. What is it?
quests.hint: Here's a tip: They are soft and can have fun patterns.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Socks keep your feet warm and make your shoes comfortable!
quests.funFact: Did you know? the longest sock ever knitted was over 3,000 feet long!

quests.instruction: We wear this that a baseball player often wears during a game. It is NOT your hat. What is it?
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It has a curved brim just at the front!
quests.explanation: Hooray! Your Cap has a curved front brim that shades your eyes from the sun!
quests.funFact: Many caps feature logos of sports teams or companies.

quests.instruction: We wear this that has a cozy pocket in the front for our hands. It is NOT your vest. What is it?
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It has a hood attached at the neck!
quests.explanation: Hooray! Your Hoodie has a warm hood attached that you can pull up over your head!
quests.funFact: You can pull the drawstrings on a hoodie tight to protect your face from the wind.

quests.instruction: What is the name for the small pouch sewn into pants or a jacket for holding tiny things? It is also the feature that some jeans have four of, two in front and two in back, but it is NOT your shoelaces!
quests.hint: Think about this: You can tuck a coin or a small toy inside it.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Pocket is a small pouch sewn in for holding coins, toys, or notes!
quests.funFact: Did you know? a pocket is a small pouch built right into a piece of clothing.

quests.instruction: What is the name for the fuzzy strip that sticks together with a satisfying rip sound? It is also the strip we press together to fasten, and pull apart to open, but it is NOT your button!
quests.hint: Think about this: It is fuzzy on one side and hooked on the other.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Velcro is a fuzzy fastener that sticks together with a satisfying rip!
quests.funFact: Did you know? velcro is a fastener made of tiny hooks and fluffy loops that stick together.

quests.instruction: We wear this that keeps all four fingers together in one warm space. It is NOT your belt. What is it?
quests.hint: Here's a clue: Your fingers snuggle together inside, not separated!
quests.explanation: Hooray! Your Mittens keep your fingers snuggled together, which makes them extra warm!
quests.funFact: Oven mitts are thick mittens used to safely hold burning hot pans.

quests.instruction: What is the name for the small, round piece we push through a little hole to close a shirt? It is also the piece that can be round, square, shiny, or shaped like an animal, but it is NOT your zipper!
quests.hint: Think about this: It pushes through a tiny hole to close clothes.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Button is a small piece that pushes through a hole to close your clothes!
quests.funFact: Did you know? a button is a small disc pushed through a slit to fasten clothes together.

quests.instruction: Think carefully: we wear this when we run and play outside in the heat, not your tights. What is it?
quests.hint: Here's a tip: You wear these when it is too hot for pants.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Shorts keep your legs cool and free to move on hot days!
quests.funFact: Did you know? they became very popular for sports in the early 20th century.

quests.instruction: What is the name for the row of tiny teeth we zip up in one smooth pull? It is also the fastener that can get stuck if a piece of fabric gets caught inside, but it is NOT your pocket!
quests.hint: Think about this: You pull a little tab up and down.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Zipper has tiny teeth that lock together in one smooth pull to close clothes!
quests.funFact: Did you know? a zipper uses two rows of metal or plastic teeth that interlock tightly.

quests.instruction: We wear this right after we towel off, before we get fully dressed, but it is not your wetsuit. What is it?
quests.hint: It ties closed with a soft belt.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Bathrobe is thick and fluffy, worn to stay warm right after a bath!
quests.funFact: They are the ultimate cozy clothing for a lazy weekend morning.

quests.instruction: We wear this before ballet class, snug from our waist to our toes, but it is not your pants. What is it?
quests.hint: They are thinner than leggings.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Tights cover your legs and feet in one thin, stretchy piece for warmth!
quests.funFact: Tights are usually made of a very thin, stretchy nylon material.

quests.instruction: What is the name for the long strings we thread through little holes and tie in a bow? It is also the strings that can come undone and need tying again while we run, but it is NOT your waistband!
quests.hint: Think about this: You tie these into a bow.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Shoelaces are the strings that tie into a bow to keep your shoes snug!
quests.funFact: Did you know? shoelaces are strings used to tie shoes tight against your feet.

quests.instruction: What do we call the edge that pops up or lies flat around the neck of a shirt? It is not your velcro!
quests.hint: Here's a tip: A tie is knotted right below it.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Collar is the folded edge of a shirt that circles your neck!
quests.funFact: Did you know? the collar is the part of a shirt that wraps around the neck.

quests.instruction: What is the name for the end of a sleeve that circles snugly around our wrist? It is also the part we push up when we want to wash our hands without getting wet, but it is NOT your zipper!
quests.hint: Think about this: It is found at the very end of a sleeve.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Cuff is the end of a sleeve that circles snugly around your wrist!
quests.funFact: Did you know? the cuff is the very end of a sleeve that wraps around the wrist.
